predictedRisks.riskDescription: The project timeline extends through October 30, 2026, seven weeks beyond the contractual end date of September 11, 2026, without a documented contract amendment. predictedRisks.reasoning: The project is currently operating in Week 12 with a planned completion date of October 30, 2026, yet the SOW specifies a September 11, 2026 end date. Historical patterns show timeline optimism bias in AI/ML projects, and the current 7-week extension without formalization exposes both parties to payment disputes, resource uncertainty, and liability gaps.
